reviews.title: The Flight Attendants Are Not Pleasant
reviews.text: One of the two flight attendants on my flight definitely had an ax to grind. She said I could not use my laptop because that was against the law in Taiwan. She said: "Using a laptop on a plane is against the laws of domestic airfare in Taiwan." I was typing on Word. My laptop was in flight mode. After I disembarked, I called the government. They told me the flight attendant made it up -- she was not telling the truth. There is no such law. The flight attendant pointed to the flight safety card and said the regulations were there as well. That was untrue. Mandarin Airlines has said they forbid laptops on their flights. This is not what the flight attendant told me. She said they were against the law on domestic flights. Actually, she was on my case from the time I boarded.
reviews.author: Patrick C

reviews.title: Small plane but with nice service
reviews.text: It’s a very small plane, only 2+2 seats a row but the distance between rows is ok. And the flight attendants are nice and friendly and always smile. Besides, flying time is quite accurate, no delay.
reviews.author: Tracy P

reviews.title: 比想像還要好太多! Better than expected!
reviews.text: 原本沒什麼期待，位子應該很小，因為是ERJ190 2/2 但其實實際坐的時候比B738還要好坐 坐裡面也不會跟別人擠，位子間距也很夠! 短短的香港線還有提供熱餐 組員服務殷切貼心 唯一小缺點就是沒有機上娛樂 但還是推薦選搭! Didn't I expected for such RMQ-HKG short haul flight. and it was ERJ190 configuration 2/2 single aisle aircraft. But I was fully surprised that it was more comfort than B738. There is sufficient leg room and I don't need to worry if I want to go to lavatory would interrupt with my neighbor. And there was decent food offered and the cabin crew also provided good service. Even though there's no entertainment in flight, But still recommend to choose.
reviews.author: TOMHSU

reviews.title: value for money
reviews.text: A good budget airline. A simple but satisfactory meal was provided even for the 1.5 hour flight, with hot meal box, water and snack. 30-kg checked bag allowance was included. Staff were nice and helpful.
reviews.author: Lawrence_Hui

reviews.title: Great Local Flight
reviews.text: We flew to Kinmen and back with no issue. A great local airlines that worked hard to stay on time. They were also gracious with our luggage because they saw we had flown international on their team flight (China Airlines). So we were able to have a few KG's more than the domestic passengers. The flight crew were helpful and knowledgable. Small drink service on both flights. The flight was a bit late but made up time. Easy to move around in Taipei.
reviews.author: Philip Thurman

reviews.title: Unexpectedly good & comfortable flight
reviews.text: First time with Mandarin Airlines on a route that I fly often, usually with HK Express. My expectations were low, as I have flown with Chinese airlines previously but Mandarin Airlines were exceptionally good - the plane was quite new, and despite being a small 2-2 configuration the seats were roomy and comfortable, and infinitely better than the same route on HK Express. Staff were friendly, all spoke English and actively engaged with me. Checked luggage was included in the cost (I booked through Expedia, so not sure if this is normal) which meant that there was plenty of space for luggage in the cabin, and they even included a meal on the 1hr 10-minute flight. For once I am looking forward to my return trip.
reviews.author: HongKongHowler

reviews.title: Mandarin Airlines
reviews.text: This is a reginal airline which operates mostly at Taiwan Main Island and other small islands. I found out they fly to other Countries too but not much. By information from its web, the Airline equipped with ATR72-600 , B737-800, ERJ-190AR ,now total of 14-16 aircrafts. I booked my tickets (round trip) via tourist agent. The check in at Airport was rapid and fast by using machine with the assistance of a ground staff (my first time self check in ), smooth and easy. A little delay due to air traffic controls. The inflight service was minium ,no movie nor music to select. The flight was a 50 minutes flight with a free drink only. I took the ATR plane with twin propellers, still quite comfortable.Smooth flight. The return trip remained the same.
reviews.author: IpJohnny

reviews.title: Very pleasant
reviews.text: The cabin is clean and the seats are wider than normal, really comfy, just like cinema chairs. The cabin crew and meal served were also nice.
reviews.author: daisy111hk

reviews.title: Flight Taichung to Saigon
reviews.text: Mandarin Airlines aka China Airways, aka not Mainland China, but Taiwan. Confused? Welcome to the Far East!!. But joking aside, it was a very pleasent 3 hour flight. Efficient, clean, very friendly (2 stewardesses for 2 passengers in Business Class). Chicken, noodle meal, wine, coffee, orange juice, hot towels, duvet. Excellent value for money. Toilet a bit cramped for my 6 foot frame, but apart from that I would highly recommend. Well done.
reviews.author: Tim W

reviews.title: Visit to Kinmen Island.
reviews.text: We have heard a lot about the Amoy, now called Kinmen Island and decided to visit the place, whilst vacationing in Taipei, Taiwan. This is our first visit and the flights by Mandarin Airlines to and from Kinmen Island were pleasant. It was a short flight and the inflight service were good and the Safety and Flight information announcements were in Mandarin and in English.
reviews.author: loy Seng y

reviews.title: Decent short hop
reviews.text: Decent short hop from Hong Kong to Taichung. Mandarin Airline's E190 does not have any IFE or screen, but the flight is only approximately 1 hour 15 mins to 1 hour 30 mins max. With the airline also serving lunch/meal with the short hop. you will be busy with finishing the meal before descent starts. Cabin Crew was extremely busy serving meals service as well as duty free service in such a short period of time. Well done.
reviews.author: E90SLAM

reviews.title: Short Hop Flight
reviews.text: Connecting flight from Hong Kong to Kaohsiung for the final leg of our journey to Taiwan. Good check in facility, staff well mannered. Budget style airline but was comfortable for the short one and a half hour flight. Hot meal served efficiently and speedily. Would recommend for this type of connecting flights to Taiwan
reviews.author: Bernard B

reviews.title: Direct Flight is a plus, but it’s a small jet. Ground checking staff is young and less experience.
reviews.text: Direct Flight is a plus, but it’s a small jet. Ground checking staff is young and less experience. It took very long time to process checking. Inflight meal not delicious. Seat is not comfortable. If there is better choice please take it, but sadly it’s none.
reviews.author: jw2018939

reviews.title: small but courteous
reviews.text: staff works very hard. 2 staff on board Embrader jet. Very basic plane with no basic ententainment. One staff did everything from serving food to issuing handouts. Impressive attitude and always smiling even trhough she worked hard.
reviews.author: Rufy V

reviews.title: What a landing....
reviews.text: The flight was pleasant from take-off to before landing. The food and drinks were standard and decent, the flight attendants friendly and cabin reasonably clean. However, during landing, there was a sudden drop in elevation. The plane was shaking hard. People were scared and started screaming. I had to clutch the armrest. My feeling was that the pilot had tried to land in one attempt while he should have pulled up and had a second try. Nevertheless, we successfully landed in one go.
reviews.author: geokantam

reviews.title: Quality service as usual
reviews.text: Co-flight with Xiamen Airlines, as a brand under Taiwan's China Airlines, Mandarin Airlines is able to maintain the quality of cabin service. The food needs improvement thou, understood that many airlines are trying to reduce cost by minimizing the food. To stand up for island of delicious food, there is no excuse to make the food taste bad of Taiwan airliners.
reviews.author: Rigg K

reviews.title: To have a Boeing for a 40 minutes flight - that's something!
reviews.text: Very convinient to fly from Sung Shan airport which actually is located in the city of Taipei. Mandarine airlines is a very good company!
reviews.author: Vadim S

reviews.title: Great cabin staff but filthy toilet
reviews.text: The flying time was only 1hour 5mins and the airplane took off a bit late. As it was a short flight, not much is expected of inflight meals even for business class. The cabin crew performed their duties very competently. The toilet in the Business Class however was apparently not cleaned throughly before the fligh. The toilet seat cover and the rim of the bowl were really off-putting and could pose health hazards. What a big let down!
reviews.author: PatrickLLLL

reviews.title: First travel by E190
reviews.text: I was first traveled by E190, the aircraft was small, it was the smallest in the Hong Kong International Airport, the weather was not that good, and the aircraft was quite small, there was turbulence during the flight, no hot drink could be served, and the feel was just like riding with a roller coaster, but the service was not very bad; flight has been changed to use 737-800 afterward, and I think passengers would be more comfortable.
reviews.author: WL CHOI

reviews.title: Wonderful flights
reviews.text: Ground staff at HKG and RMQ are helpful and friendly...help us get the comfy seats and follow up my special meal even our return flight had been changed within short notice Inflight: seats are clean and have enough space Cabin crews are same helpful as ground staff as well as very efficient
reviews.author: cancer1998

reviews.title: First time visit, won't be the last! 優良的服務
reviews.text: Flight number - AE391 Date: 11th June 2016 Flying from Sung Shan Airport (Taipei) to Taitung which was a pretty short flight. The flight attendant was extremely friendly and attentive, she could speak both Mandarin (local language) and a bit of English, I was in emergency seating and received a thorough safety briefing both in Mandarin and English. The flight was smooth, comfortable and on time, light refreshments were also provided. My first time using Mandarin Airlines but it won't be the last. Thank you for a pleasant flight in Taiwan.
reviews.author: South Melbourne's #1 Reviewer
